title: Tweeter — Real-Time Distributed Messaging Application
description: A distributed desktop application inspired by Twitter, implementing real-time communication and client-server architecture using Java.
results: Implemented real-time messaging using WebSockets for live user interaction
Designed client-server communication with clear separation of concerns (MVC architecture)
Handled concurrent user interactions and message propagation across the system
Explored distributed system fundamentals in a stateful communication environment
